summary: Frontend-only test of mobile vertical spacing between header and page titles across 7 pages. inicio.html passes (h2 top=148px). Desktop regression clean (padTop 87px, no h2 margin change). However 5 inner pages (inscricao, dados-inscricao, confirmacao, pagamento-pix, inscricao-realizada) still show titles glued to header (top=75px, marginTop=0) because the __mobile_compact_v1 rule for h2.tituloPagina is OVERRIDDEN by a later stylesheet rule with !important. termos.html h1 top=114px (below 130 target but visually reasonable).

ui_bugs.issue: Mobile margin-top: 40px !important from __mobile_compact_v1 is overridden by a later CSS rule 'h2.tituloPagina { margin: 0px 0px 20px !important; padding: 0px 0px 12px !important; }'. Result: title top = 75px, marginTop = 0px. Titles still visually glued to the header on mobile.
h1 top=114px on mobile (below 130px target). Slightly close to header but has some breathing.

issues: Title h2.tituloPagina sits at y=75px, effectively glued to the Cebraspe header — the reported bug is NOT fixed on these 5 pages.

root_cause: In inscricao/dados-inscricao/confirmacao/pagamento-pix/inscricao-realizada pages, another stylesheet declares 'h2.tituloPagina { margin: 0px 0px 20px !important; padding: 0px 0px 12px !important; }' AFTER the __mobile_compact_v1 block in the CSS cascade. Both use !important, so the LATER rule wins → margin-top:40px is nullified to 0. Additionally, these pages do not have a .vc_row.grid_section wrapper (they use .Miolo container), so the padding-top:100px rule doesn't help them either.
action_items: Increase specificity of h2.tituloPagina mobile rule OR move __mobile_compact_v1 block to load AFTER all site stylesheets. Suggested fix: change selector to 'body h2.tituloPagina' or 'html body h2.tituloPagina' inside the @media block, and/or move the <style id="__mobile_compact_v1"> tag to the very end of <body>.

Also add mobile padding-top on the container of inscricao pages, e.g. '@media(max-width:768px){ body.concurso128 .Miolo { padding-top: 40px !important; } }' — since these pages use .Miolo, not .vc_row.grid_section.
For termos.html: verify h1 top >=130 (currently 114). May want to slightly increase mobile padding on its container as well.
critical_code_review_comments: The __mobile_compact_v1 style block is duplicated in 7 HTML files (~4.3KB each). Consider extracting to an external CSS file loaded last to (a) avoid duplication and (b) guarantee it wins the cascade order.
Relying on !important stacking is fragile; specificity-based selectors (body h2.tituloPagina) are more robust.

success_rate.frontend: 29% (2/7 pages pass mobile spacing; inicio ok, termos borderline, 5 fail)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-run the same 7-page mobile measurement (viewport 390x844) after main agent adjusts CSS specificity/ordering. Success criteria: getBoundingClientRect().top of the main title element on each page should be >= 100px (target 130+). Do NOT break desktop 1440x900: .vc_row.grid_section padTop must remain ~87px and h2 marginTop must remain 0px there.
rca of the issue: The @media (max-width:768px) rule 'h2.tituloPagina { margin-top: 40px !important; ... }' declared inside <style id="__mobile_compact_v1"> is present in all 5 affected pages, but it is overridden because another stylesheet later in the cascade declares 'h2.tituloPagina { margin: 0 0 20px !important; padding: 0 0 12px !important; }' with equal !important weight and later position. CSS cascade rules: same specificity + same importance → last one wins. Fix by (a) moving the __mobile_compact_v1 style block to be the last style in the document, or (b) bumping specificity (e.g. body h2.tituloPagina). Reproduce: open https://concurso-inscricao.preview.emergentagent.com/inscricao.html at 390x844 → h2.tituloPagina.getBoundingClientRect().top === 75.
